candidate.rationale: The function returns alloc::format!("{:?}", v), which depends on the runtime Debug impl for T and on formatting/alloc internals that have no corresponding Verus spec-level abstraction in vstd. There is no existing public spec function that maps a value T: Debug to its formatted string, so any relation would either be unspecifiable or unsound (tightly coupling to implementation details or hidden state).
risks: The Debug implementation for T is not specified in Verus; asserting a concrete relation could be unsound if implementations differ or change.
Formatting may depend on platform/runtime details or cause panics; a spec that ignores these would be misleading.
Proposing a weak vacuous postcondition (e.g., about length or non-null) offers little verification value and may hide real behaviors.
